openai_roberta_base.decision: AI iff score > threshold; ties are classified human

binoculars_falcon7b.decision: AI iff raw Binoculars ratio < threshold; ties are human

provenance.reference_population: Common123 only: full126 and historical pilot ASR have different denominators
provenance.join: source_id + method + rewrite_id, text hashes and metadata, then detector; row-by-row check against saved paired detector scores
provenance.bertscore: aligned_bert_f1_rescaled_bidirectional_mean; supplemented from catalogue, not the raw document F1
provenance.calibration: Original frozen thresholds; target5%FPR on separate calibration humans; no recalibration

baseline_check: All eight common-panel ASRs checked before conditional semantic analysis
analysis_status: Retrospective descriptive analysis. NLI distributions and earlier ASR results were already inspected. These definitions are written before calculating this experiment; they are not blind or preregistered thresholds.
denominator: All original-detected sources of the common panel for the detector, unchanged across methods, semantic definitions and tau.
bootstrap_unit: source_group_id; resample the 123 sources jointly, retaining all four methods and both detectors in each draw
interval_policy: Pointwise paired-source percentile 95% bands; report undefined resamples and degenerate empirical intervals. Wilson two-sided 95% for individual ASR proportions, including zero events.
group_population: Only orig_detected sources: compare evaded rewrites with rew_detected rewrites within each method and detector.
definitions: Moderate and stringent are operational proxy-score requirements, not human-verified preservation labels
score_comparison: BERTScore and NLI thresholds use the same numerical grid, not matched calibration or identical evidence contexts
empty_groups: No imputation; unavailable comparisons or resamples are explicitly counted
causal_interpretation: None. Association between evasion and proxy support does not identify meaning lost or a causal cost
selection_limit: The common panel already excludes incomplete generations; semantic scores can therefore be more favorable than for all attempts
